pilot.note: Exploratory only. Ran on suite-v2 sizes and an earlier interface; never pooled with main results.

margin_justification: At most one additional failure per 20 runs (5 percentage points) in a non-safety-critical transformation workflow. Chosen before the main run and not tuned to results.
moderation_policy: Provider content rejections are terminal failures. They are not retried, are recorded as adapter errors with unknown usage, remain in every denominator, and a sensitivity analysis reports results excluding only provider-rejection runs.
attribution_policy: Only provider-reported total usage is recorded. Per-message feedback and verification attribution remain null. H3 is evaluated with total input tokens and returned feedback bytes as an aggregate proxy, never as per-message attribution.

analysis.primary: D versus A: total tokens and success non-inferiority
